provenance.method: Loaded and answered Rank passages at fp16: one ordinary Load, then two Rank passages requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Rank passages requests on a query and four short documents.

provenance.method: Sum of macOS phys_footprint_peak over all Arsenal worker processes (only the measured model was loaded) across one ordinary Load, then two Rank passages requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; MiB converted to GB (10^9 bytes). Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

secondsPerRequest.basis: One warm Rank passages request on a query and four short documents.

provenance.method: Wall time of the timed (second) Rank passages request, one sample, after one ordinary Load, then two Rank passages requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; includes the API round trip. Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.
